correctness.rationale: Rebuilt first-step equations for transient states 11,10,01 with 00 absorbing, solved their three-by-three linear system and checked all positive denominators including c=0 or B. With D=ab(a+b+B), the means are [a²+ab+b²+(a+b)B+c(B-c)]/D, [(b+c)(a+b+B-c)]/D, [(a+B-c)(a+b+c)]/D. Weighted derivative T'(c)=[B+a w10-b w01-2c]/D, second derivative −2/D<0. Projection of (B+a w10−b w01)/2 to [0,B] uniquely optimizes, including equality at endpoints. Independently evaluated 756 exact-rational generator/inequality assertions; this finite grid does not prove the general theorem.
